name: Page Speed Script Optimizer
author: WP Craftbench

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress performance optimization with conditional plugin loading! This powerful script optimizer helps you speed up WordPress by loading plugins conditionally based on where they’re actually needed. Disable plugin on specific pages, exclude heavy plugins from key pages, and reduce plugin bloat to improve Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.

Key Features (Lite Version):
* Conditional Plugin Loading – Load plugins only where needed (up to 2 conditions)
* Disable Plugins Per Page – Exclude heavy plugins from specific pages
* WordPress Performance Optimization – Improve Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS)
* Reduce Plugin Bloat – Smart asset loading control and script optimization
* Plugin Load Filter – Multiple plugins per condition with exclude mode
* Performance Plugin Management – Easy-to-use interface with visual condition management
* Page-Based Targeting – Target specific pages for optimization
* Must-Use Plugin Creation – Early filtering for maximum performance impact

How Plugin Load Optimization Works:
1. Create Conditions – Set up rules to deactivate plugins per page (2 conditions max in Lite)
2. Select Heavy Plugins – Choose which plugins to exclude from specific pages
3. Target Key Pages – Apply conditions to specific pages for maximum performance impact
4. Save & Speed Up – Activate your conditional load manager for instant WordPress performance optimization

Pro Version Available:
Unlock advanced performance optimization with Page Speed Script Optimizer Pro featuring:

🚀 AI-Powered Performance Analyzer:
* Intelligent Recommendations – AI automatically detects optimization opportunities
* Real-time Performance Monitoring – Track load times, memory usage, and Core Web Vitals
* One-Click Optimization – Apply AI recommendations instantly with bulk operations
* Performance Metrics Dashboard – Professional interface with detailed analytics
* Impact Analysis – See potential load time savings before applying changes
* Plugin Performance Insights – Identify which plugins are slowing down specific pages

🎯 Advanced Targeting & Conditions:
* Unlimited Conditions – Create as many optimization rules as needed
* Categories & Tags Targeting – Target posts by category, tag, or custom taxonomy
* Post Type Targeting – Optimize specific post types (posts, pages, products, etc.)
* Include/Exclude Modes – Flexible plugin loading control
* Advanced Page Targeting – Target any page, post, or custom content type
* Bulk Condition Management – Manage multiple conditions efficiently

📊 Professional Features:
* Performance Analytics – Comprehensive performance tracking and reporting
* Optimization History – Track all applied optimizations and their impact
* Advanced Dashboard – Modern, intuitive interface with detailed insights
* Priority Support – Get help from performance optimization experts
* Regular Updates – Stay current with latest WordPress performance best practices

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external services or third-party APIs. All functionality operates locally within your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/page-speed-script-optimizer/ directory, or install through WordPress admin
  2. Activate the performance plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Script Optimizer in your WordPress admin to create your first conditional loading rule
  4. Select plugins to load conditionally and choose target pages for optimization
  5. Save your condition and enjoy faster WordPress performance with improved Core Web Vitals!
sections.faq:
How many conditional loading rules can I create?

The Lite version includes basic conditional plugin loading functionality. Pro version offers unlimited conditions and advanced asset loading control options.

What’s the difference between Lite and Pro versions?

  • Lite: Basic conditional loading with pages targeting to speed up WordPress
  • Pro: Advanced features including unlimited conditions, include/exclude modes, categories & tags targeting for comprehensive plugin load optimization

Upgrade to Pro Version →

Will this performance plugin break my site?

The conditional load manager is designed to be safe. However, always test conditions on a staging site first, especially when disabling plugins that provide critical functionality.

Can I target categories and tags for plugin load filtering?

Categories and tags targeting is available in the Pro version. The Lite version supports pages targeting to exclude heavy plugins from specific pages.

Can I use include mode to load plugins conditionally?

Include mode is available in the Pro version. Lite version focuses on exclude mode functionality for WordPress performance optimization.

How does the plugin targeting work to improve Core Web Vitals?

You can disable plugins on specific pages to reduce plugin bloat and improve performance on key pages like homepage and checkout, directly improving Core Web Vitals scores.

Does this script optimizer work with caching plugins?

Yes! The conditional plugin loading works at the WordPress core level and is compatible with most caching solutions for maximum performance optimization.

What happens if I deactivate this performance plugin?

All plugins will load normally as if the conditional loading conditions never existed. Your site functionality will be fully restored without any asset loading restrictions.
